posts.zh:
dsh-rewind 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。同一会话窗口内的 in-place 对话回退（不 fork，Claude Code /rewind 语义）：每条消息的 ↶ 按钮把模型上下文回退到任意用户消息，可选用磁盘持久化的 before-backups 还原工作区文件。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-605b69e11255e78f3bcd.html
posts.en:
dsh-rewind is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. In-place conversation rewind in the same session window without forking (Claude Code /rewind semantics): a per-message ↶ button cuts the model context back to any user message, with an optional Claude-Code-style file restore from disk-persisted before-backups.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-605b69e11255e78f3bcd.html
